Hi Sofia — thanks for the docs, this is helpful. Short answers up front, then next steps: 

1) Fiscal agent evidence: We need a signed appointment document that explicitly names SilkRoad Logistics UK Ltd and the appointed fiscal representative. The simple fiscal agent form attached to this thread (Signed_Fiscal_Agent_Form.pdf) is our standard intake; if you can sign that and return, that will speed internal processing. If your fiscal agent provides a separate letter, that works too.

2) E-invoicing: Currently our AP ingestion supports both emailed PDF invoices to our PO-specific address and PEPPOL delivery. If you plan to send via PEPPOL, please include the recipient PEPPOL ID in the vendor record and CC: accounts@redwoodinference.com during the first invoice so Finance can map the channel. If PEPPOL is not available on your side, PDF via the PO address is fine.

3) PO tagging / legal entity mapping: Procurement will need to know which Redwood legal entity the PO should be routed to (we typically split by remit entity: Redwood Inference UK Ltd vs Redwood Inference US Inc). Please confirm that invoices for UK-supplied services should be tagged to Redwood Inference UK Ltd — that will enable correct VAT treatment (reverse charge or standard VAT depending on service).

Next steps (action items):
- Sofia: please return the signed fiscal agent form (I attached a blank version) and confirm preferred invoice delivery method (PEPPOL ID or PDF).
- Laura / Ben: once Sofia returns the signed form, can you create the vendor record, attach the fiscal agent evidence, and tag the vendor to the UK remit entity? Also set expected invoice channel per vendor response.

Target timeline: if we get the signed form today we can have the vendor live for PO issuance by EOD tomorrow (Dec 13) — finance permitting.

Cheers,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
